notes.title: We launched a new game (Shu), and Chip is on sale!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We hope you're all well.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5950266/f352b360e5724c1003af86dc3cb1369de4e5021b.png

We've just launched a new game here on Steam, called  Shu. It's an action-platformer with speedrunning elements, and is filled to the brim with achievements and trading cards for you to collect. It also has a 10% launch discount at the moment, so please head over and pick it up when you get chance!

To celebrate the launch, Chip also has a massive discount at the moment. It's 70% off in the 'Fellow Humans' sale, so if you're a puzzle fan yet to pick it up or have a friend who might enjoy it, now's the time.

Thanks again for playing our games - we appreciate the support!

Coatsink

notes.title: Happy Holidays! Controls update.
notes.content:
Happy Holidays everyone!

We've just pushed an update out, focusing on tweaks to the controls/interface.

Update notes:

- Keyboard Camera Controls (WASD / Arrow Keys) 
- New selection reticule to show what the user is about to select
- Object selection is based on tile again now (due to reticule) and no the objects sprite
- New settings screen with control information 

We'd love to hear your feedback, as always. ːChipJoyː

notes.title: Update 1.1.1 Available now: Like A Bot Out Of Hell Part 1 (New Levels and Mechanics)
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

CHIP is back with part 1 of an all-new level pack, featuring 5 (of 25) levels filled with shiny new robots and vistas. Full update notes can be found below:

 - Two new mechanics (Jumper and Rotator).
  - Jumper - This propels the bolt over the next tile
  - Rotator - This rotates all objects and map tiles around it within in set radius
- 5 new levels with these mechanics, and more to come
- New level pack ("Like a bot out of hell")
 - New level pack background
 - New tileset

As always, we really appreciate your feedback (good or bad) in the forums and will continue to work on tweaks and new (always free) content.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Update 1.1 is live!
notes.content:
Woohoo! We've just pushed update 1.1 to Steam. It includes the following additions and tweaks:

- Steam Cloud Support added for Saved Games
- Changed object selection to allow easier rotation, along with other selection tweaks
- Bug Fixes

If Chip has not been automatically updated for you, try restarting Steam. Feel free to leave comments regarding the update, and any other questions you might have. We'd love to hear from you!
